# Vojislav Miloradovic - Machine-Readable Credentials Archive

> **Last Generated:** 2026-10-07 16:51 UTC
> Curated, structured, and token-optimized record of professional certifications, badges, and learning achievements across Microsoft Learn, AWS, Google Cloud, Credly, LinkedIn, and Google Developer.

## Portfolio Overview & Total Counts
- **Microsoft Learn**: 36,683 completed units | 4,928 total achievements | 6,153,275 XP
- **Google Cloud Skills**: 406 badges
- **AWS Skill Builder**: 1,008 completed courses/activities
- **Credly**: 721 credentials
- **LinkedIn**: 1,809 verified external certifications
- **Google Developer**: 172 milestone badges | 1,673 codelabs & activities
